span.p:
Worker reports
voice · text · icons
English or Arabic

div.style: color: rgb(207, 250, 254) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
1 · Foresee
72-hour zone heat forecast
WBGT with a 90% interval

div.style: color: rgb(207, 250, 254) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
2 · Plan
CP-SAT moves heavy work out of
harsh hours, fits breaks to shade,
respects acclimatization

div.style: color: rgb(207, 250, 254) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
3 · Check
independent rule re-validation
and capacity certificate

div.style: color: rgb(219, 234, 254) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
6 · Act
protective task with an owner,
a deadline and an evidence level

div.style: color: rgb(219, 234, 254) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
7 · Prove
evidence E0 to E4; verified only
at the required level

div.style: color: rgb(255, 237, 213) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
8 · Dispute
'This didn't happen' reopens and
escalates; the reporter stays anonymous

div.style: color: rgb(207, 250, 254) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
9 · Resolve
only a fresh independent check
made after the dispute
